products.name: Maleic Bond Repair Complex Hair Shampoo & Mask Duo - Dull, Frizzy, Weak & Damaged Hair
products.description: A single-active, minimalist hair or scalp treatment targeting one specific mechanism relevant to adolescent hair or scalp physiology — adolescence often brings hormonally-driven shifts in scalp oil production and hair texture, which this treatment addresses through one clearly defined active mechanism rather than a broad, multi-ingredient formula. Its formulation is built around a Maleic Bond Repair Complex that penetrates the hair cortex to help reform broken disulfide bonds, the covalent sulphur-sulphur links between cysteine amino acids that give hair its structural strength and are broken down by bleaching, heat and chemical services. Apply as directed to the scalp or lengths as part of a simple, consistent routine; visible change follows the hair's natural growth cycle, so results build gradually over consistent use.
